title: Dock Column and Dock Column Left on the only tab of a split pane move it into a new docked column (cx-39lm)
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/dock-split-pane-e2e.py (kept): a split pane's only tab, docked by each action
Split Right: a new terminal pane in the same column takes the focus; its tab is its pane's only tab

the screen's split tree becomes a strip with the docked column (layout facet); the column keeps another pane, so another pane anchors the move; on 5895d36d3b8 (cx-39lm's parent) the tab left through its own pane and the action answered 'move-tab-to-column failed'

a second workspace with one terminal pane, below the first, for the Dock Column Left round; a socket run without focus files it in the window without showing it (WindowManager.claimNew), so no shown facet changes and the settle is the wait
Select Workspace 2: the window shows the workspace new-workspace made
the same move pinned to the left edge

invariants: dock and dock-left each succeed on a split pane's only tab (the cx-39lm regression answered move-tab-to-column failed)
after each dock the moved tab sits in a new docked column of the same screen, and the split it left keeps the other pane
no tab is lost or duplicated: the workspace has as many terminal tabs after each dock as before it
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the script's column.undock check on the moved tab's pane: the case compares the docked layout in the snapshots instead
the dock's edge and width defaults from layout.dockColumnEdge and layout.dockColumnMode (the bench config leaves them unset)
the script's window capture (debug.window_snapshot); captures are the media tours' job
